# semaphore_ex_global_policy_guardrail_impact (Action)

Evaluates or compares policy guardrails without publishing or saving a policy. Executes only through explicit Action invocation. Progress reports a bounded, non-secret summary. Full preview results are available through the matching ephemeral resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "semaphore_ex_global_policy_guardrail_impact" "example" {
  config {
    inputs = [{ project_id = 1, intent = "task", evaluated_at = "2026-09-21T12:00:00Z", template = { id = 2, application = "ansible", source = "task" }, executor = { type = "local", image_reference_kind = "none" } }]
  }
}

# terraform apply -invoke=action.semaphore_ex_global_policy_guardrail_impact.example
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `inputs` (Dynamic) Native list of 1–100 value-free PolicyGuardrailEvaluationInput objects.
